title: Flatness descends to one stage of a directed preorder
statement: Let I be a directed preorder and R:I -> CommRing a diagram of Noetherian rings. Let c be a limiting cone on R.op followed by Spec, with affine vertex. Fix i in I, a finitely presented morphism f:Xi -> Spec(R_i) [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], and a finitely presented O_Xi-module M [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. If the tensor pullback of M [def-pc-module-pullback] to the canonical fibre product Xi times Spec(R_i) c.pt [def-pc-base-change] is flat over c.pt [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], then there exist j in I and hij:i <= j such that the canonical pullback of M to Xi times Spec(R_i) Spec(R_j) is flat over Spec(R_j). Only one stage is asserted, not all later stages or arbitrary cartesian models.

proof.text: The object i makes I nonempty and filtered. Choose a final functor F:J -> I from a nonempty directed partial order and t with i <= F(t). Pull back f and M to stage F(t), preserving finite presentation and hence quasi-coherence. Restrict the cone along the initial functor F.op; its vertex and limit property remain. Cartesian pasting, tensor-pullback composition and comparison identify the restricted limit module with the original one and transfer flatness.

Apply partial-order flat-module descent to the pulled-back module and take one of its stages s >= t. Put j=F(s), so i <= j. Cartesian pasting and tensor-pullback composition identify the resulting stage module with the canonical pullback directly from i to j, and cartesian-model comparison transfers flatness. No propagation to later original stages is needed here.

theorem exists_isFlatOver_of_isPullback_limit_preorder_stage
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)]
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (M : Xi.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hflat : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      (pullback.fst f (c.π.app (op i)))).obj M).IsFlatOver
      (pullback.snd f (c.π.app (op i)))) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j),
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))).obj M).IsFlatOver
        (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
